$comment: Versions of this distribution published BEFORE the repository move, from
dotmac_starter_mt. Recorded here as coordinates; their TAGS are not, and
must never be, recreated in this repository.
git filter-repo rewrote every commit on the way here, so a tag named
`dotmac-deployment-control-v0.1.0a2` created in this repository would point
at a tree that is NOT the one published under that name. One version would
name two commits and every pin against the original coordinate would become
unidentifiable. This is not hypothetical: the extraction's first filter-repo
pass carried 110 tags through the rewrite, including both of these, pointing
at rewritten SHAs. They were purged before the first push.
`peeled_commit` is the COMMIT the annotated tag resolves to in the Starter,
not the tag object's own id. A reader with dotmac_starter_mt confirms every
row with `git rev-list -n1 <tag>`; the tag object id is recorded beside it so
the annotation itself is addressable too.
These artifacts are immutable. Nothing in this repository may re-upload,
delete or yank them — dotmac_vendor_control_plane pins a2 by version AND by
wheel/sdist hash, so the bytes are load-bearing for a live consumer.

releases.release_run_note: Not recorded in the dossier at extraction time. Absent rather than guessed: a run id invented to fill the field would be a coordinate that resolves to nothing.

Tagged only after the wheel was installed back from the private index and conformance-checked. a2 rather than a1 is the first admissible composition version: a1 published the stable-verdict contract but did not recover the losing first-arrival transaction after the receipt unique constraint selected a winner.
